html:
Andrianampoinimerina was king of Imerina in the central highlands of Madagascar from about 1787 to 1810, who reunited the Merina and laid the base of a kingdom that came to rule most of the island.

From his royal hill of Ambohimanga he ended years of civil war among Merina princes, took Antananarivo and made it his capital. He organised irrigated rice farming on the plains, markets, and laws, and used forced labour for dikes and canals.

He is remembered for saying the sea is the limit of my rice field, meaning his heirs should rule all of Madagascar. His son Radama I began that conquest. His kingdom, the Merina state, was the one the French conquered in 1895.
sum: Andrianampoinimerina was king of Imerina in the central highlands of Madagascar from about 1787 to 1810, who reunited the Merina and laid the base of a kingdom that came to rule most of the island.
